capabilities: save each canvas's center position and zoom
restore the saved view when a canvas is reopened
remember the current view on demand via a command
keep saved views attached when canvases are renamed or moved
skip restoring incompatible canvas views with a notice
extras: No settings to configure. Requires desktop Obsidian 1.13.7+; mobile is untested. Manual install steps are given until it is published. Views are stored in the plugin's data.json and may sync across devices without conflict resolution.
intentEvidence: Return to an Obsidian canvas where you left it.
problem: Obsidian canvases reopen at their default view, so users have to pan and zoom back to where they were working each time.
summary: Canvas companion plugin that saves the center position and zoom of each canvas and restores that view when the canvas is reopened.
